about: Data-version manifest of the native tool task (#1088, R-1088-14, R-1088-16). Tool: artefacts.py. `data` pins the version in use: one tag of the private Hugging Face dataset repository, and the commit the tag points at. A file rebuilds (rebuild: a command run from this directory, public sources only) or comes from the version (version_path); heldout files are not needed by the public CI; the sha256 is of the bytes in place. Sources stay in the tree.
